title: Manali, Kasol & Tosh
reportingPoint: Departure is in the evening from Delhi or Chandigarh. Final pickup details are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip; report at the pickup point 30 minutes early.
overview:
Manali and the Parvati Valley in one trip: this **4 Nights / 5 Days** group trip leaves Delhi every Friday evening (pickup from Chandigarh too) for an overnight journey to Manali.

Day 1 covers Hadimba Temple, Old Manali and Mall Road with a bonfire dinner. Day 2 takes in Solang Valley, the Atal Tunnel and Sissu (subject to time and weather). Day 3 drives to Kasol via Kullu, where Beas rafting and paragliding are optional (own cost), for a camp night with a bonfire. Day 4 heads to Tosh via Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara for a night in the village. Day 5 returns to Kasol for its cafes before the overnight journey home. Prices start at ₹13,500 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra); Christmas and New Year batches cost more.
highlights: Hadimba Temple, Old Manali and Mall Road
Solang Valley and the Atal Tunnel to Sissu
Optional Beas rafting and paragliding in Kullu (own cost)
Camp night in Kasol with a bonfire and light music
Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara on the way to Tosh
A night in Tosh village with Parvati Valley views

itinerary.title: Departure from Delhi / Chandigarh
itinerary.content:
Assemble at the pickup point in Delhi or Chandigarh, meet your team captain and the group.
Depart in the evening for the overnight journey to Manali in an AC Tempo Traveller or bus.
Halt for dinner on the way (not included).

itinerary.title: Reach Manali | Hadimba Temple | Old Manali | Mall Road
itinerary.content:
Reach Manali in the morning, check in at the hotel and freshen up.
Local sightseeing: Hadimba Temple, Old Manali and Mall Road.
Back to the hotel for dinner with a bonfire and light music.
Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Solang Valley | Atal Tunnel | Sissu
itinerary.content:
After an early breakfast, head out for the day.
Cover Solang Valley en route, drive through the Atal Tunnel and enjoy the views from Sissu Valley (subject to time and weather).
Back to the hotel in the evening for dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Manali to Kasol via Kullu | Camp night
itinerary.content:
Wake up early, have breakfast and check out.
Leave for Kasol via Kullu, where you can enjoy Beas river rafting and paragliding (own cost).
Reach Kasol in the evening and check in to the camps.
Dinner with a bonfire and light music.

itinerary.title: Kasol to Tosh via Manikaran Sahib
itinerary.content:
Wake up early and have breakfast.
Leave for Tosh via Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara.
Check in at Tosh and explore the village and its Parvati Valley views.
Dinner and overnight stay in Tosh.

itinerary.title: Tosh to Kasol | Departure
itinerary.content:
Wake up early and have breakfast.
Transfer to Kasol for its cafes and local cuisine.
Depart for home in the evening, reaching Delhi or Chandigarh the next morning. Tour ends.

includes: Stay: 2 nights in a hotel in Manali, 1 night in Kasol and 1 night in Tosh
AC tempo traveller, Innova or AC deluxe bus, as per group size
All sightseeing as mentioned in the itinerary
excludes: Rafting, paragliding and other adventure activities
Costs from road blocks, accidents or landslides (paid on the spot)
Anything not mentioned in the inclusions

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: The trip leaves Delhi every Friday evening for an overnight journey to Manali, with pickup from Chandigarh too. Final pickup details are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip.

faqs.q: How much does the Manali, Kasol & Tosh trip cost?
faqs.a: On regular dates: ₹13,500 per person on quad sharing, ₹14,000 on triple and ₹14,500 on double. Christmas and New Year batches: ₹14,500 quad, ₹15,500 triple and ₹16,500 double. 5% GST is extra.

2 nights in a Manali hotel, 1 night in Kasol camps and 1 night in Tosh, 8 meals (4 breakfasts and 4 dinners), AC transport as per group size, all sightseeing in the itinerary, a bonfire with music and a tour curator.
No. Beas river rafting, paragliding and other adventure activities in Kullu are at your own cost, as are 4x4 vehicle charges during snow rides.
The first two nights are in a hotel in Manali, the third in camps in Kasol and the fourth in Tosh village. Extra mattresses are provided for triple and quad sharing.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat with a ₹3,000 advance per person (UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Paytm or net banking) and pay the rest 24 hours before boarding. 5% GST is extra on the trip price.
The ₹3,000 advance is not refunded under any circumstances. There are no refunds for inclusions you don't use, and bookings can't be transferred.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack a down or main jacket, thermals, socks and gloves, outdoor shoes, a daypack and personal medication. The full list is under Things To Pack.

thingsToCarry: Valid government photo ID (no boarding without it)
